name: National Savings Time Deposit (TD)
benefit: Interest payable, Rates, Periodicity etc.Minimum Amount for opening of account and maximum balance that can be retained6.9% to 7.5%Minimum INR 1000/- and in multiples of 100. No maximum limit.**Interest Rates** Interest rates From 01.01.2024 to 31.03.2024 - 1 year TD Account: Rate of interest - 6.9% - 2 year TD Account: Rate of interest - 7.0% - 3 year TD Account: Rate of interest - 7.1% -
_eligibility_text: 1. The individual must be a resident citizen of India. 1. The individual may open an account as a single adult. 1. The guardian may open an account on behalf of a minor. 1. The guardian may open an account on behalf of a person of unsound mind (Authorised Account). 1. The minor who has attained the age of 10 years may also open and operate the account. 1. The individual Joint Account (up to three adults) (Joint A or Joint B) - Joint ‘A’ type, to be operated by all the depositors or the surviving depositors jointly. - Joint ‘B’ type, to be operated by any of the depositors or the surviving depositors separately Note:Any number of accounts can be opened in individual’s name or jointly with another Note: Upon reaching the age of 18 years, account holders must submit a new Account Opening Form (AOF) and fresh KYC documents at their Post Office to convert their minor account into to an adult account Note: Accounts can also be opened through e-Banking or Mobile Banking facility. It is to be noted that Post Office Savings Account is a prerequisite for availing internet banking facility (Please [Click ](https://ebanking.indiapost.gov.in/corp/AuthenticationController?FORMSGROUP_ID__=AuthenticationFG&__START_TRAN_FLAG__=Y&__FG_BUTTONS__=LOAD&ACTION.LOAD=Y&AuthenticationFG.LOGIN_FLAG=1&BANK_ID=DOP)here or visit www[dot]ebanking[dot]indiapost[dot]gov[dot]in)
